subject: FINDING: frozen Duo visual and native input are not coherently owned
body: Source-confirmed architecture gap on current main: FoldSurface accessibility overlays use FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE; legacy DisplayMirrorHost is also touch-transparent; Gen3 Alpha1 CLOSING uses SnapshotSurface while OPENING uses LiveBlurSurface. Android documents FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE as never receiving touch, and accessibility windows are trusted for pass-through. Therefore a frozen closing frame can remain the user's apparent UI while touch acts on independently changing native content underneath. Proposed invariant: frozen/occluding Duo visual must quarantine native touch; live/non-occluding visuals remain pass-through. Recommended architecture is a host-local exact-token interaction lease subordinate to the visual owner, activated only after exact owner.markActive(token), terminally revoked before detach, and unable to re-block from stale callbacks. If the gate cannot activate, degrade/remove the frozen visual rather than keep stale pixels touch-through. No production write performed.
